title: Walmart’s $29 Black Friday Phone Is INSANE For Emulation!
summary: ETA PRIME tests the 2026 Motorola Moto G Power purchased for $29.88 at Walmart, demonstrating a carrier bypass method and emulation performance across PSP, GameCube, PS2, and Nintendo 3DS titles.

blocks.text: The video examines the 2026 Motorola Moto G Power available at Walmart for $29.88 through Straight Talk prepaid service. It documents a Test DPC QR code method to bypass the carrier activation screen, converting the device into a Wi-Fi-only handheld. Hardware details include the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, 8 GB of RAM, a 120 Hz display, and vegan leather back. The presenter configures USB-C controller support, installs frontends via Aurora Store, and enables a Game Time "Turbo Mode" for performance gains before running benchmarks in PPSSPP, Dolphin, NetherSX2 Classic, and Lime3DS.

Budget-conscious retro gaming enthusiasts may find the price-to-performance ratio relevant for portable emulation up to PlayStation 2 and GameCube generation. Results shown reflect this specific unit, firmware version, and chosen settings; other devices or configurations will yield different frame rates and compatibility. All emulator benchmarks represent the creator's own observations and are not independently verified by this publication. Users should supply their own legally obtained BIOS files and game images when replicating any tests.
